snapshots.csv.description: Every snapshot of every included project, one row per project per sampled commit. Identical columns to the per-project projects/<id>/snapshots.csv files.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: Stable corpus identifier, GitHub owner and repository joined by a double underscore.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Author timestamp of the sampled commit.

fields.name: sha
fields.description: Full git commit SHA the snapshot was extracted at.

fields.name: commit_msg
fields.description: Commit subject line, truncated to 120 characters.

fields.name: N
fields.description: Nodes in the lineage DAG, one per resolved dbt model.

fields.name: M
fields.description: Directed edges, one per ref() call between two resolved models.

fields.name: too_small
fields.description: True when N < 5 and the D1-D4 descriptors were skipped.

fields.name: D1_csi
fields.description: Community stability index. Fraction of consecutive steps in a 15-point Louvain resolution sweep whose partitions differ by NVI < 0.1.

fields.name: D1_n_comm
fields.description: Communities found at Louvain resolution gamma = 1.

fields.name: D2_max_gini
fields.description: Maximum over depth of the Gini coefficient of the blast-radius distribution.

fields.name: D3_alg_conn
fields.description: Algebraic connectivity, the second-smallest Laplacian eigenvalue of the undirected connected skeleton.

fields.name: D3_norm_gap
fields.description: Algebraic connectivity divided by the largest Laplacian eigenvalue.

fields.name: D3_fiedler_bim
fields.description: Bimodality coefficient of the Fiedler vector.

fields.name: D4_cycle_rank_norm
fields.description: Cycle rank (M - N + C) of the undirected skeleton, divided by N.

fields.name: n_components
fields.description: Connected components of the undirected skeleton.

fields.name: giant_component_frac
fields.description: Largest connected component divided by N. D1 and D3 are computed on the giant component alone, so this says how much of the reported N they describe.

fields.name: isolated_frac
fields.description: Models with no ref() in either direction, divided by N.

fields.name: n_staging
fields.description: Models classified as staging by name prefix or directory.

fields.name: n_intermediate
fields.description: Models classified as intermediate.

fields.name: n_mart
fields.description: Models classified as mart, fact, dimension or reporting.

fields.name: n_unclassified
fields.description: Models matching no layer rule.

fields.name: n_sql_files
fields.description: Model SQL files read at this commit, before stem collision collapsing. Equals N unless two files in different directories share a filename.

fields.name: n_dbt_projects
fields.description: dbt_project.yml files visible at this commit, vendored packages excluded.

drift_events.csv.description: Consecutive-snapshot relative changes above 20 percent in D1_csi, D3_alg_conn or D4_cycle_rank_norm.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: Stable corpus identifier, GitHub owner and repository joined by a double underscore.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Author timestamp of the sampled commit.

fields.name: sha
fields.description: Full git commit SHA the snapshot was extracted at.

fields.name: descriptor
fields.description: Which descriptor drifted.

fields.name: prev
fields.description: Descriptor value at the preceding snapshot.

fields.name: curr
fields.description: Descriptor value at this snapshot.

fields.name: pct_change
fields.description: 100 * |curr - prev| / |prev|. Emitted only above 20.

fields.name: commit_msg
fields.description: Commit subject line, truncated to 120 characters.

corpus_index.csv.description: One row per included project, the yield table.

added_after_build.composition: production analytics estate, dbt package, documentation site, or demo. See composition_and_yield.json for the rule order and its validation.
added_after_build.composition_rule: which rule assigned the composition label
added_after_build.has_integration_tests: the repository ships an integration_tests project, the strongest independent package signal at 0.857 accuracy
added_after_build.consumes_packages: a packages.yml exists, meaning the repository consumes dbt packages

excluded.csv.description: Every repository that was cloned and extracted but did not meet the inclusion criteria, with the reason.

longitudinal/longitudinal_<id>.csv.description: The per-project snapshot rows again, under the flat name the phase_4 scripts glob for. Byte-identical content to projects/<id>/snapshots.csv.

sampling_frame.csv.description: The full candidate population and the screening outcome for each entry, including repositories never cloned.

MANIFEST.json.description: Dataset provenance. Repository URL, default branch, HEAD SHA, resolved model paths, first and last snapshot SHA and date, extraction timestamps, and a SHA-256 for every other file in the release.

composition_and_yield.json.description: Composition distribution, the classifier rules and their validation, and the corpus size against the snapshot floor.

d1_order_sensitivity.json.description: How far each descriptor moves when only the node insertion order changes. D2 and D4 move by exactly zero, D1_csi by up to 0.571.

conventions.missing: Empty string in CSV, null in JSON.
conventions.timestamps: Snapshot dates are git author timestamps, local to the commit. Extraction timestamps are UTC with a Z suffix.
conventions.encoding: UTF-8, RFC 4180 quoting, LF line endings.
